Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor banking setup and PO mapping request

Hi Camila,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call this morning. Per our discussion, attaching the completed W-9 and the bank authorization form. We need Redwood to confirm the PO field Redwood will place on invoices and the exact remit string so our AR team can automate payment posting.

Attachments:
- sapphire_w9.pdf (W-9)
- sapphire_bank_authorization.pdf (signed ACH form)

A few quick questions from our side:
1) What PO format should we include on each invoice? (example: RWD-2027-####)
2) Can you confirm Redwood’s micro-deposit amounts/process to validate the account?
3) Is there a remittance label (structured string) we should include on invoice PDF metadata?

Appreciate the help — Ari

--
Ari Patel
Director, Finance Operations
Sapphire Supply
ari.patel@sapphire-supply.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor banking setup and PO mapping request

Hi Ari — great to meet earlier. Thanks for sending the forms. I’ve looped in Ben from FinOps and Marissa from Vendor Ops to finalize the payment details. Next steps below:

1) Banking validation: Ben will initiate a micro-deposit verification (2 small deposits) to the account in the bank authorization form. Please confirm when you see them and reply with the exact amounts.

2) PO format: Our procurement system assigns PO numbers like RWD-2027-3381. Please include "PO: RWD-2027-####" on the invoice header and in the PDF metadata (if possible). If you can include a separate line in the invoice CSV export as "po_number" that’s ideal.

3) Remittance string: Use this structured remit tag so our AP can auto-apply payments: 
   RemitTo:SapphireSupply|INV:{invoice_number}|PO:{po_number}|TaxId:{vendor_tax_id}

4) Attachments: We received the W-9 and ACH form (thanks). If you have a bank letter from the bank (bank_letter.pdf) that speeds our verification, please attach it.

Ben, can you start the micro-deposit testing this afternoon?

Ari — once micro-deposits land, please reply with amounts and we’ll confirm.

Camila Reyes
Vendor Onboarding Manager
Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Hi team — placing the micro-deposit now to the account in the provided ACH form. Expected posting window: 24-48 hours depending on bank. Test deposits will be two different amounts under $1.00. Please confirm both amounts exactly when you see them.

Operational notes for Sapphire: 
- Assigned PO (for autopay/first invoice): RWD-2027-3381
- When you submit invoices to pay@redwood.com, include the PO in subject line and the remit string in the invoice PDF text. Example invoice footer we expect: 
   RemitTo:SapphireSupply|INV:INV-2027-0912|PO:RWD-2027-3381|TaxId:12-3456789

- If you want EDI/FTP delivery for invoice batches, we can add Marissa to scope next week.

I’ll mark the vendor record as "pending verification" and move to active after Ari confirms amounts.

Ben Carter

Redwood Inference

Hi Ben / Camila — confirmed the two micro-deposits this morning: $0.17 and $0.62. That matches the amounts in our account history. We’ve attached a bank letter (sapphire_bank_letter.pdf) as an extra verification artifact.

We will format invoices per the template below starting with next billing cycle:
- Invoice PDF header: Sapphire Supply | Tax ID: 12-3456789
- Invoice number: INV-YYYY-NNNN
- PO line (visible): PO: RWD-2027-3381
- Remit string embedded in PDF footer and exported CSV as field "remit_tag": RemitTo:SapphireSupply|INV:{invoice_number}|PO:RWD-2027-3381|TaxId:12-3456789

We should be live for payments once you flip the vendor from pending to active. Please confirm when Redwood has completed the activation and we’ll send the first invoice.

Thanks — Ari
